answer: A name gets on the books only through Chartered cowherd guild bond, because a bond cowherds lodge after herd reviews. For every name, an examination charge of £38, charged again each time a name fails leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The mirror is on the docket. The vault is checked, not assumed. The clerk notes crystal.
